## ITInBoKb type

Union type for both inline and reply keyboards.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITInBoKb = ITBottomKb | ITInlineKb;
```
**References:** [ITBottomKb](./gramstax.itbottomkb.md)<!-- -->, [ITInlineKb](./gramstax.itinlinekb.md)

## Remarks

Allows methods to accept either keyboard type.
